author: KEXP
description: Austin, Texas' STRANGE LOT take a DIY approach to building their immersive, psychedelic sonic world. Live on KEXP with host Jewel Loree, the band share unreleased music off their forthcoming self-titled record, including the track "All I Know."
title: STRANGE LOT performs "All I Know" & more Live on KEXP
